tags.name: om-map
tags.description: The map root. Layers, overlays, behaviors, widgets, and stories are children.

attributes.name: center
attributes.description: Initial center "[lng, lat]".

attributes.name: zoom
attributes.description: Initial zoom.

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: Initial pitch in degrees.

attributes.name: bearing
attributes.description: Initial bearing in degrees.

attributes.name: basemap
attributes.description: Basemap: a registered preset name, "maplibre" (demo style), a style URL, or "none" (standalone canvas).

attributes.name: basemap-key
attributes.description: Provider API key for keyed basemap presets (maptiler-*) — publishable origin-restricted key; or call OmMap.configureBasemap once.

attributes.name: hover-pick
attributes.description: Hover-pick cadence: "rest" (default — one GPU pick when the pointer stops, none while it sweeps; kills the per-mousemove ReadPixels stall on integrated graphics), "continuous" (deck-native, per frame), "off" (click picking only), or a throttle interval in ms (leading + trailing).

attributes.name: pick-cursor
attributes.description: CSS cursor shown while the pointer is over a pickable feature (default "pointer" — the is-this-interactive affordance). "none" disables.

attributes.name: attribution
attributes.description: Set "false" to opt out of the compact attribution control shown with basemaps.

attributes.name: lighting
attributes.description: Scene lighting preset for 3D content — seeds ambient/sun/camera values that lighting-* attributes override. Absent = deck.gl default lights.

attributes.name: lighting-ambient
attributes.description: Ambient light intensity (always-on fill), e.g. 0.9.

attributes.name: lighting-sun
attributes.description: Sun (directional light) intensity; 0 removes the sun.

attributes.name: lighting-sun-azimuth
attributes.description: Sun compass bearing, degrees clockwise from north [0, 360).

attributes.name: lighting-sun-elevation
attributes.description: Sun height above the horizon, degrees [0, 90].

attributes.name: lighting-sun-date
attributes.description: ISO 8601 or epoch ms — computes the sun's azimuth/elevation from solar position at the map center (shadow studies). Overrides azimuth/elevation.

attributes.name: lighting-camera
attributes.description: Camera-following fill light intensity (model inspection); 0 removes it.

attributes.name: terrain
attributes.description: 3D elevation surface: a registered terrain preset, a {z}/{x}/{y} DEM URL (needs terrain-decoder), or "off". Replaces an active basemap while on. Geographic layers drape by default (per-layer terrain attribute overrides).

attributes.name: terrain-decoder
attributes.description: DEM RGB decoder: "terrarium", "mapbox-rgb", or {rScaler,gScaler,bScaler,offset} JSON. Required for raw DEM URLs; presets carry their own.

attributes.name: terrain-exaggeration
attributes.description: Vertical relief multiplier, applied in the DEM decoder; 1 = true relief.

attributes.name: terrain-max-zoom
attributes.description: DEM tileset zoom cap — the provider's REAL limit (a too-high cap requests 404 tiles and blanks the terrain).

attributes.name: terrain-texture
attributes.description: Optional {z}/{x}/{y} imagery template draped over the surface (satellite, etc.).

attributes.name: clip-box-min
attributes.description: 3D clip box corner "[lng, lat, elevation]" — with clip-box-max, cuts every layer (opt out per-layer with clip="off") down to what's inside the box. Axis-aligned.

attributes.name: clip-box-max
attributes.description: 3D clip box opposite corner "[lng, lat, elevation]" — see clip-box-min.

attributes.name: clip-box-invert
attributes.description: Show what's OUTSIDE the clip box instead of inside.

attributes.name: clip-box-highlight
attributes.description: Dim clipped-out geometry instead of discarding it (non-destructive preview) — nothing disappears, it just de-emphasizes.

attributes.name: snap
attributes.description: XY snapping for draw/measure vertex capture: space-separated agents (vertex, edge, midpoint). Refines deck's own hover/click pick to the nearest vertex/edge/midpoint of the ALREADY-picked feature within snap-tolerance pixels — searches every pickable vector layer's geometry by default, opt a layer out with snap="off". Hold Space to suppress momentarily.

attributes.name: snap-tolerance
attributes.description: Snap search radius in screen pixels (default 12).

attributes.name: widget-style
attributes.description: Layout-token sugar: space-separated key:number pairs → --om-widget-* custom properties (e.g. "gap:10 opacity:0.9"). Keys: inset, gap (shorthands), inset-x/-y, gap-x/-y, opacity, radius, size. Numbers are px except opacity.

attributes.name: widgets-hidden
attributes.description: Hide-all: every widget goes visibility:hidden (state survives — no removal) except attribution and widgets-toggle, which never hide. Toggle via the set-widgets-visible action or <om-widget type="widgets-toggle">; transient UI, not an undo step; story-scrub-capturable.

attributes.name: widgets-fold
attributes.description: Responsive auto-fold is on by default at map widths ≤ --om-widget-fold-breakpoint (640px): managed widgets move into one accessible drawer per map side. Set "off" to disable.

attributes.name: widgets-dim
attributes.description: Set "off" to disable collision-dim: by default a slot dims (--om-widget-opacity-dimmed, 0.35) while an open <om-overlay> popup covers it, rather than the popup dodging.

attributes.name: validate
attributes.description: Run manifest validation and show the on-page error panel.

attributes.name: map-id
attributes.description: Optional authored UUID identifying this map artifact (telemetry dedup across visits/pages — not a visitor id). Opt-out: delete it.

attributes.name: license-key
attributes.description: OnlyMapJS license token (om_live_…) — lifts the free-tier limits (5 layers / 25k rows per layer) and removes the badge. Publishable, origin-restricted; or call OmMap.configureLicense once.

attributes.name: telemetry
attributes.description: Set "off" to disable usage telemetry for this map (global opt-out: OmMap.configureTelemetry).

attributes.name: headless
attributes.description: No renderer — parsing/IR only (tests, SSR).

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Headless viewport width (px).

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Headless viewport height (px).

tags.name: om-layer
tags.description: A deck.gl layer declared as markup — attributes map to props (kebab-case), get-* attributes compile as accessors.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Layer id — referenced by behaviors, steps, widgets, and overlay anchors.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: deck.gl layer class.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Data URL (JSON, GeoJSON, CSV/TSV, Arrow/GeoArrow IPC, Shapefile .shp, KML, GPX, FlatGeobuf .fgb, GeoParquet .parquet, CityJSON) or wss:// stream; omit for inline <script type="application/json">.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Human-readable name shown in the legend and layer list.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Shorthand fill color (hex or CSS color) — also the legend swatch.

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: Layer visibility.

attributes.name: opacity
attributes.description: Layer opacity 0–1.

attributes.name: pickable
attributes.description: Enables hover/click picking for behaviors and tooltips.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: GPU prop transitions, e.g. "get-fill-color 800ms, get-radius 400ms".

attributes.name: filter-field
attributes.description: GPU filter field (DataFilterExtension) — pair with filter-range. Single dimension; for more than one, use filter-fields instead.

attributes.name: filter-range
attributes.description: Filter range "[min, max]" for filter-field.

attributes.name: filter-soft-range
attributes.description: Soft edges "[min, max]" for the filter.

attributes.name: filter-fields
attributes.description: Multi-dimension GPU filter (up to 4) — JSON array of {field, range, softRange?} objects, e.g. '[{"field":"mag","range":[3,9]}]'. Wins over filter-field/filter-range if both are set.

attributes.name: filter-category
attributes.description: Categorical GPU filter field — pair with filter-categories. Single dimension; for more than one, use filter-category-fields instead.

attributes.name: filter-categories
attributes.description: JSON array of categories to keep, for filter-category.

attributes.name: filter-category-fields
attributes.description: Multi-dimension categorical GPU filter (up to 4) — JSON array of {field, categories} objects, e.g. '[{"field":"fuel","categories":["Coal","Gas"]}]'. Wins over filter-category/filter-categories if both are set.

attributes.name: classify-by
attributes.description: Classified symbology: the numeric field to compute class breaks from (quantile/equal-interval/jenks). Installs a fill-color accessor + auto legend; an authored get-fill-color/color wins.

attributes.name: classify-scale
attributes.description: Classification mode: quantile (default), equal-interval, or jenks.

attributes.name: classify-classes
attributes.description: Number of classes, 2–12 (default 5).

attributes.name: classify-ramp
attributes.description: Named color ramp for classification: viridis (default), plasma, inferno, magma, cividis, turbo, blues, greens, oranges, purples, reds, ylorrd, rdbu, spectral.

attributes.name: dash
attributes.description: Dashed line pattern "[dashLength, gapLength]" (or "6 3") in line-width units. PathLayer/GeoJsonLayer/PolygonLayer/TripsLayer.

attributes.name: dash-justified
attributes.description: Stretch each segment's dashes to start and end on a dash (boolean).

attributes.name: highlighted-id
attributes.description: Feature id to highlight (set by the highlight-feature action).

attributes.name: terrain
attributes.description: Behavior under an active map terrain: drape onto the surface, offset (sit on it — the 3D-model default), or off. Absent = the type default.

attributes.name: clip
attributes.description: Opt out of the map's active clip box (<om-map clip-box-min/max>) with "off" — clipping applies to every layer by default once a box is configured.

attributes.name: snap
attributes.description: Opt out of the map's active XY snapping (<om-map snap>) with "off" — snapping searches every layer's own geometry by default once enabled, including a BIMLayer's edge overlay.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Stream entity identity field — messages upsert by this key (wss data).

attributes.name: flush
attributes.description: Stream burst coalescing interval (default 250ms).

attributes.name: refresh
attributes.description: Polling interval for REST snapshots, e.g. "5s" — each poll replaces the data.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: registerSource decoder plugin name for stream messages.

attributes.name: site-origin
attributes.description: Georeferencing (Tile3DLayer, PathLayer): where the model sits, "[lng, lat]" or "[lng, lat, elevation]". Overrides a tileset's baked position; required to place a PathLayer of local metres.

attributes.name: site-heading
attributes.description: Georeferencing: bearing in degrees clockwise from true north. On its own, rotates the model where it stands.

attributes.name: site-scale
attributes.description: Georeferencing: uniform scale multiplier (default 1).

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: anchor="surface": anchor each row INSIDE its own polygon (point-on-surface) — on-map labels/annotations with no authored coordinates. An authored get-position wins.

attributes.name: visible-zoom-range
attributes.description: Per-layer zoom visibility "[minZoom, maxZoom]" — hidden outside min ≤ zoom < max (minzoom/maxzoom convention), any layer type. Composes with visible; the layer stays in the legend/switcher while zoom-hidden.
